node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic two-triple reduction
node.statement: If a cubic colored interpolant sends the six reduced h=7 roots to exactly two colors with multiplicities 3+3, the two full cubic fibers factor L. Coefficient comparison adds q_2(d)r^2+q_1(d)r+q_0(d)=0; intersecting it with the residual conic gives the fixed degree-fourteen polynomial R_33 with leading coefficient -576000 and 32 norm-fiber gcd endpoints.
node.notes: Exact necessary reduction for the 3+3 cubic color partition only. The 32 norm-gcd verdicts are unrun because Modal is spend-blocked; all other cubic partitions remain open.
